# cloudraya_ssh_keypair (Resource)

A CloudRaya SSH keypair. The API exposes no update call, so every configurable attribute forces a new keypair.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# CloudRaya has no update call for keypairs, so changing any argument replaces
# the keypair.
resource "cloudraya_ssh_keypair" "deploy" {
  name       = "deploy-key"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Keypair name. Changing this forces a new keypair.
- `public_key` (String) OpenSSH-format public key. Changing this forces a new keypair; leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the keypair. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new keypair.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (String) SSH keypair identifier.
- `user_id` (String) Owning user.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# An SSH keypair is imported by its ID.
terraform import cloudraya_ssh_keypair.deploy <ssh_keypair_id>
```
